headline: Segura's 11th-inning single walks off D-backs, 7-6
recap: Jean Segura lined a one-out single to right field in the bottom of the 11th inning, scoring Ronald Torreyes from second base and giving the Phillies a 7-6 win over the Arizona Diamondbacks. Torreyes had reached on a fielder's choice and moved to second on Odubel Herrera's single before Segura's hit ended it.

Aaron Nola and Arizona starter Taylor Widener both worked into the sixth inning. Nola struck out seven over 5.1 innings, and both runs charged to him scored in the sixth on Josh Rojas's RBI triple and a Josh VanMeter sacrifice fly. Widener went five innings and gave up a two-run homer to Bryce Harper, who finished 2-for-3 with a double and two walks.

The lead changed hands twice late. J.T. Realmuto's two-run single in the seventh put the Phillies ahead 4-2, Christian Walker's two-run homer off Ian Kennedy tied it in the ninth, and Ketel Marte's two-run shot off Enyel De Los Santos put Arizona back in front in the 10th before Brad Miller answered with a two-run homer in the bottom of the 10th to force extra innings.
